body: Using the two uploaded portraits, create a wedding editorial photograph of the same two adults. Keep both faces recognizable and their proportions natural. Candid laughter, a gentle breeze, warm film colors, realistic skin and fabric, flattering late-afternoon side light. Frame from the knees upward in a vertical 4:5 composition. No extra people, text or logos.
